children: A FOIA request uncovered the alternate email address former Attorney General Pam Bondi used for government business, according to Bloomberg.

Bloomberg News senior investigative reporter Jason Leopold said attorneys general have used alternate email addresses to conduct government business for more than a decade, and that knowing those aliases can make FOIA searches easier for journalists and requesters.

title: Pam Bondi’s DOJ Email Alias Exposed in FOIA Request
